title: MongoDB aggregation pipeline artifact (fixture expected/ shape)
description: Deliberately lightweight: a MongoDB aggregation pipeline is an ordered array of single-key stage objects ($match, $sort, $skip, $limit, $group, $addFields, ...). This schema only enforces the array-of-single-key-stage-object shape, not any one stage's internal correctness; since #1643 a Mongo compiler (Craticula.Mongo) checks the rest semantically, by compiling every in-scope artifact and comparing it key for key. Extended by #1630's dialect-parity category to optionally carry MongoDB's query-level 'collation' option alongside the pipeline (SEM-1's CI mechanism for $eq/$in/sort/range): collation is a find()/aggregate() command-level option, not a pipeline stage, so it cannot be expressed as an element of the bare array below. Most fixtures still use the bare-array form unchanged; only fixtures whose Mongo mechanism specifically needs a non-default collation use the wrapper-object form.

items.description: A single pipeline stage: exactly one operator key (e.g. '$match'), per the Mongo aggregation pipeline convention.

collation.description: The query-level collation option (SEM-1): applies to $eq/$in/$gt/$gte/$lt/$lte/$sort in this pipeline, never to a $regex stage (contains has no collation-compatible operator, per SEM-1/SEM-7).
